The programmer uses `IllegalStateException` to signal an unrecoverable error that should not occur. In the context of the method, which is expected to always have a valid work item when the key is active, this throw is meant to indicate a serious programming error. Typically, such runtime exceptions are not expected to be caught by callers; they are intended to propagate and indicate a need for debugging or fixing the code.
